reuse.why: Adds one isHoliday predicate in shared/schedules.ts and routes isNonWorkingDay and both app.ts holiday checks through it, though app.ts could have reused the existing isNonWorkingDay (weekend-or-holiday) instead of keeping its own d.isWeekend || isHoliday expression.

duplication.why: The holiday-matching rule now exists once; the remaining weekend-or-holiday composition in app.ts is a pre-existing duplicate of isNonWorkingDay that the diff keeps rather than removes.

placement.why: The predicate lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other date-adjustment helpers that the server layer already imports from.

scope.why: Only the holiday comparison and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small, readable single definition of what a holiday match is; a maintainer would only want the app.ts expressions folded into isNonWorkingDay.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks call isHoliday; app.ts keeps its pre-existing inline weekend||holiday composition rather than isNonWorkingDay, but that composition predates the change.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the holiday comparison is defined once in isHoliday.
